```{r setup, include=FALSE}
mar.tab <- function(t) {
  m <- matrix(t)
  dim(m) <- dim(t)
  dimnames(m) <- dimnames(t)
  m <- rbind(m, colSums(m))
  m <- cbind(m, rowSums(m))
  dimnames(m)[[1]][nrow(m)] <- "Total"
  dimnames(m)[[2]][ncol(m)] <- "Total"
  names(dimnames(m)) <- names(dimnames(t))
return(m)
}

pct.mar.tab <- function(t, d=1) {
  m <- matrix(t)
  dim(m) <- dim(t)
  dimnames(m) <- dimnames(t)
  names(dimnames(m)) <- names(dimnames(t))
  m <- round(100*prop.table(m, d))
  return(m)
}

kable.tab <- function(t, ...) {
  h <- c(1, ncol(t))
  names(h) <- names(dimnames(t))
  kable(t, format="latex", booktab=TRUE, ...)  %>%
    add_header_above(h)
}

dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
```

```{r}

## Read the two files
pcal1_PMP_peak_pc <-  read_csv(here("Round 1/PCal Datasets/PeakData/PMP_PupCall_SingleTrialPeaks.csv"))
pcal2_PMP_peak_pc <-  read_csv(here("Round 2/DataForStats/PMP_PupCall_SingleTrialPeaks.csv"))

## Compute mean absolute difference
mean(abs(pcal1_PMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp - pcal2_PMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp), na.rm=TRUE)

## Cmpute RMSD
sqrt(sum((pcal1_PMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp - pcal2_PMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp)^2, na.rm=TRUE)/sum(!is.na(pcal1_PMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp)))

pcal1_VMP_peak_pc <-  read_csv(here("Round 1/PCal Datasets/PeakData/VMP_PupCall_SingleTrialPeaks.csv"))

sqrt(sum((pcal1_VMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp - pcal2_VMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp)^2, na.rm=TRUE)/sum(!is.na(pcal1_VMP_peak_pc$PeakAmp)))

```

# Figure 2E (was 4E) Analysis

## Using Linear Mixed Effects Models

Do the analysis with the raw PeakAmp values to check for heteroscedasticity.

```{r}

l_all_pc_peak_raw_lmer <-
  lmer(PeakAmp ~ Layer * Call * Group + Age + (1 | Animal),
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer != "All" & Call %in% c(1, 18, 30, 44, 60)),
       REML=TRUE)
print(anova(l_all_pc_peak_raw_lmer))
plot(l_all_pc_peak_raw_lmer)
# summary(l_all_rest)
```

Perform it again on the log(`PeakAmp`) values.

```{r}
l_all_pc_peak_lmer <-
  lmer(log(PeakAmp) ~ Layer * Call * Group + Age + (1 | Animal), 
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer != "All" & Call %in% c(1, 18, 30, 44, 60)),
       REML=TRUE)
icc(l_all_pc_peak_lmer)
print(anova(l_all_pc_peak_lmer))
plot(l_all_pc_peak_lmer)

# summary(l_all_pc_peak_lmer)
VarCorr(l_all_pc_peak_lmer)
summary(rePCA(l_all_pc_peak_lmer))

```

Reviewer #4 requests that analyses be carried out at the individual animal level.  In these analyses, we follow the recommendation of Gelman and Hill (2007)^[Gelman, A., & Hill, J. (2007). _Data analysis using regression and multilevel/hierarchical models._ Cambridge University Press.] by using multilevel regression as a way to take into account the nested nature of the data within each mouse.  They characterize the multilevel approach as partial pooling, weighting the estimates based on the variance within and between the results from each mouse.   Additionally, we use Satterthwaite's (1946)^[Satterthwaite, F. E. (1946). _An approximate distribution of estimates of variance components._ Biometrics Bulletin, 2(6), 110–114. https://doi.org/10.2307/3002019] well known approximation for the denominator degrees of freedom in these and in subsequent $F$ tests.

### Illustrate Why Age & Group are problematic

```{r}


avg_dat <- pcal_peak_pc %>%
  filter(Layer == "All") %>%
  summarise(meanPeak = mean(PeakAmp, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by=c("Group", "Animal", "Age")) %>%
  mutate(zAge = scale(Age), zGroup = scale(as.numeric(Group)))

ggplot(avg_dat, aes(x=Group, y=Age)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width=.5) +
  geom_jitter(width=.1, alpha = .5)

```



### `Group` Differences within each `Call` and `Layer`

This computes and tests the `Group` difference interaction at each level of `Call` and `Layer`.  It indicates whether the difference between peak call power and resting power is significantly different for virgins vs. fathers.

```{r}
l_all_pc_peak_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call:Layer) # , lmerTest.limit = 16093)

l_all_pc_peak_emm_sum <- summary(l_all_pc_peak_emm, by = "Call", adjust = "fdr")
l_all_pc_peak_emm_sum$contrasts

l_all_pc_peak_ef <- 
  eff_size(l_all_pc_peak_emm, sigma=sigma(l_all_pc_peak_lmer),
           edf=df.residual(l_all_pc_peak_lmer))
l_all_pc_peak_ef

write_csv(left_join(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_emm_sum$contrasts),
          mutate(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_ef),
                 contrast = str_remove_all(contrast, '[()]')),
          by = join_by(contrast, Call, Layer),
          suffix=c(".contr", ".eff_size")),
          here("Round 2/PCal-output/peak-pc-pmp-vmp-contr-effsize.csv"))

### Average across layers
# emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call,
#         p.adjust="hochberg")$contrasts

l_all_pc_peak_m_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call)
l_all_pc_peak_m_emm$contrasts
summary(l_all_pc_peak_m_emm$contrasts, by=NULL, adjust="fdr")

l_all_pc_peak_m_ef <- 
  eff_size(l_all_pc_peak_m_emm, sigma=sigma(l_all_pc_peak_lmer),
           edf=df.residual(l_all_pc_peak_lmer))
l_all_pc_peak_m_ef

write_csv(left_join(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_m_emm$contrasts),
          mutate(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_m_ef),
                 contrast = str_remove_all(contrast, '[()]')),
          by = join_by(contrast, Call),
          suffix=c(".contr", ".eff_size")),
          here("Round 2/PCal-output/peak-pc-m-pmp-vmp-contr-effsize.csv"))

## AVREC
l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer <-
  lmer(log(PeakAmp) ~ Call * Group + Age + (1 + Group | Animal),
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer == "All" & Call %in% c(1, 18, 30, 44, 60)),
       REML=TRUE)
print(anova(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer))
plot(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer)

l_all_pc_peak_avrec_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call)
l_all_pc_peak_avrec_emm$contrasts

l_all_pc_peak_avrec_ef <- 
  eff_size(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_emm, sigma=sigma(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer),
           edf=df.residual(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_lmer))
l_all_pc_peak_avrec_ef

write_csv(left_join(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_emm$contrasts),
          mutate(as_tibble(l_all_pc_peak_avrec_ef),
                 contrast = str_remove_all(contrast, '[()]')),
```

Plot layer by layer plus marginal

```{r}
l_all_pc_peak_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_lmer, specs=c("Layer", "Call", "Group"))

l_marg_pc_peak_emm <-

  ggplot(aes(x=Call, y=emmean, group=Group, color=Group, fill=Group)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=asymp.LCL, ymax=asymp.UCL), 
                width=0.5, position=dodge) +
  ## scale_color_viridis_d(option="G") +
  ## scale_fill_viridis_d(option="G") +
  facet_wrap("Layer") +

l_all_pc_peak_t %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  ## filter(Freq != "delta") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Call, y=exp(emmean), group=Group, color=Group, fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=exp(asymp.LCL), ymax=exp(asymp.UCL)), 
                width=0.5, position=dodge) +
  facet_wrap("Layer") +
  ggtitle("Exponentiated Log (Raw Scale) Power Values (95% CIs)")

```

## Computing Mean for Each Condition for Each Animal

```{r}
pcal_peak_pc_avg <- pcal_peak_pc %>%
  filter(Call %in% c(1, 18, 30, 44, 60)) %>%
  summarise(meanPeakAmp = mean(PeakAmp, na.rm=TRUE),
            meanLogPeakAmp = mean(log(PeakAmp), na.rm=TRUE),
            .by=c(Animal, Age, Group, Layer, Call)) %>%
  mutate(cAge = Age - mean(Age))
str(pcal_peak_pc_avg)

pcal_peak_pc_avg_All <- pcal_peak_pc_avg %>%
  filter(Layer == "All")
pcal_peak_pc_avg_All_w <- pcal_peak_pc_avg_All %>%
  select(-meanPeakAmp, Age) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Layer, Call), 
              values_from = meanLogPeakAmp)

pcal_peak_pc_avg_Layer <- pcal_peak_pc_avg %>%
  filter(Layer != "All")
pcal_peak_pc_avg_Layer_w <- pcal_peak_pc_avg_Layer %>%
  select(-meanPeakAmp, Age) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Layer, Call), 
              values_from = meanLogPeakAmp) %>%
  mutate(cAge = Age - mean(Age))

```


```{r, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

### Using Multivariate Repeated Measures ANOVA

l_all_pc_peak_raw_mv <-
  lm(as.matrix(select(pcal_peak_pc_avg_All_w, All_1:All_60)) ~ 
       Group + cAge,
     data = pcal_peak_pc_avg_All_w)
idata <- data.frame(Call=factor(c(1, 18, 30, 44, 60)))
idata

l_all_pc_peak_raw_Anova <- 
  car::Anova(l_all_pc_peak_raw_mv, idata=idata,
             idesign = ~ Call,  type=3)
summary(l_all_pc_peak_raw_Anova)


```


### Using afex with aov_4

```{r}
## Just AVREC
l_all_pc_peak_ancova <- 
  aov_4(meanLogPeakAmp ~ Call*Group + cAge + (Call | Animal),
  data = filter(pcal_peak_pc_avg, Layer == "All"), factorize=FALSE)

anova(l_all_pc_peak_ancova)

l_all_pc_peak_ancova_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_ancova, pairwise ~ Group | Call)

summary(l_all_pc_peak_ancova_emm)$contrasts

## All except AVREC

l_pc_peak_ancova <- 
  aov_4(meanLogPeakAmp ~ Layer*Call*Group + cAge + (Layer:Call | Animal),
  data = filter(pcal_peak_pc_avg, Layer != "All"), factorize=FALSE)

anova(l_pc_peak_ancova)

l_pc_peak_ancova_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_pc_peak_ancova, pairwise ~ Group | Call:Layer)

summary(l_pc_peak_ancova_emm)$contrasts
```

```{r}
l_marg_ct_peak_emm <-
  emmeans(l_all_ct_peak_avrec_lmer, specs=c("Click", "Group")) 

l_marg_ct_peak_t <- l_marg_ct_peak_emm %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(asymp.LCL = "lower.CL",
         asymp.UCL = "upper.CL")

l_all_ct_peak_t <- 
  bind_rows(as_tibble(l_all_ct_peak_emm),
          l_marg_ct_peak_t) %>%
  mutate(Layer = fct_expand(Layer, "AVREC", after=0)) %>%
  replace_na(list(Layer = "AVREC"))
  
l_all_ct_peak_t %>%
  arrange(Layer, Click, Group) %>%
  mutate(`exp(emmean)` = exp(emmean)) %>%
  kable(digits=4, booktabs=TRUE, longtable=TRUE,
        caption="Means and 95\\% CIs to use for figures") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width=FALSE)

l_all_ct_peak_t %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  ## filter(Freq != "delta") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Click, y=emmean, group=Group, color=Group, fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=asymp.LCL, ymax=asymp.UCL), 
                width=0.5, position=dodge) +
  ## scale_color_viridis_d(option="G") +
  ## scale_fill_viridis_d(option="G") +
  facet_wrap("Layer") +
  ggtitle("Log Power Values")

l_all_ct_peak_t %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  ## filter(Freq != "delta") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Click, y=exp(emmean), group=Group, color=Group, fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=exp(asymp.LCL), ymax=exp(asymp.UCL)), 
                width=0.5, position=dodge) +
  facet_wrap("Layer") +
  ggtitle("Exponentiated Log (Raw Scale) Power Values (95% CIs)")

```


# Figure 3C (was 5C) Analysis

Create a "Volume" Factor

```{r}
pcal_peak_pc <- pcal_peak_pc %>%
  mutate(Volume=case_when(Call %in% c(18, 48, 45, 49, 53) ~ "Loud",
                          Call %in% c(7, 30, 16, 31, 57) ~ "Quiet",
                          TRUE ~ NA))
         
```

## Loud Calls

Examine the log(`PeakAmp`) values.

```{r}
l_loud_pc_peak_lmer <-
  lmer(log(PeakAmp) ~ Layer * Call * Group + Age + (1 | Animal),
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer %in% c("II", "IV") & !is.na(Volume) & Volume == "Loud"),
       REML=TRUE)
print(anova(l_loud_pc_peak_lmer))
plot(l_loud_pc_peak_lmer)
# summary(l_all_rest)
```

### `Group` Differences within each `Call` and `Layer`

This computes and tests the `Group` difference interaction at each level of `Call` and `Layer`.  It indicates whether the difference between peak call power and resting power is significantly different for virgins vs. fathers.

```{r}
# emmeans(l_all_pc_peak_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call:Layer,
#         p.adjust="hochberg")$contrasts

l_loud_pc_peak_emm <- 
  emmeans(l_loud_pc_peak_lmer, pairwise ~ Group | Call:Layer)
l_loud_pc_peak_emm_sum <- summary(l_loud_pc_peak_emm, by = "Call", adjust = "fdr")
l_loud_pc_peak_emm_sum$contrasts

l_loud_pc_peak_ef <- 
  eff_size(l_loud_pc_peak_emm, sigma=sigma(l_loud_pc_peak_lmer),
           edf=df.residual(l_loud_pc_peak_lmer))
l_loud_pc_peak_ef

write_csv(left_join(as_tibble(l_loud_pc_peak_emm$contrasts),
          mutate(as_tibble(l_loud_pc_peak_ef),
                 contrast = str_remove_all(contrast, '[()]')),
          by = join_by(contrast, Call, Layer),
          suffix=c(".contr", ".eff_size")),
          here("Round 2/PCal-output/peak-pc-loud-pmp-vmp-contr-effsize.csv"))
```

# **Incorrect** Figure 5D Analysis

I realized belatedly that the analysis below is completely different from what is given in the paper.  Here is what the paper says ---

> Fathers’ peak amplitude responses were normalized to (i.e. divided by) the corresponding mean virgin response and pooled across all loud and quiet calls respectively for the AVREC and layer traces (top to bottom, left to right). The group means across loud and quiet calls were compared between fathers and virgins, and the normalized father group means were compared across loud and quiet calls with Student’s $t$ tests . . . . 

I don't know how the normalization was computed, so I can revisit this and I can do Figure 5E if it seems important.  I'll add that the tests that appear to have been done may not have been quite right depending upon the effect of the normalization.

Examine the log(`PeakAmp`) values --- excluding `All` rows.

```{r}
l_lq_pc_peak_lmer <-
  lmer(log(PeakAmp) ~ Layer * Volume * Group + (1 | Animal),
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer != "All" & !is.na(Volume)),
       REML=TRUE)
print(anova(l_lq_pc_peak_lmer))
plot(l_lq_pc_peak_lmer)
# summary(l_all_rest)
```

All layers togetrher using `All` rows.

```{r}
l_lq_avg_pc_peak_lmer <-
  lmer(log(PeakAmp) ~ Volume * Group + (1 | Animal),
       data=pcal_peak_pc, 
       subset=(Layer == "All" & !is.na(Volume)),
       REML=TRUE)
print(anova(l_lq_avg_pc_peak_lmer))
plot(l_lq_avg_pc_peak_lmer)
# summary(l_all_rest)
```
